disabledLayerPolicy: Disabled layers are exported individually for reference only, excluded from composite/normal/additive animations.
recipe: Original width curves, 60Hz decoded clip samples at 30FPS, source-active original layers with material UV flow/disturb/dissolve. Line01 has three active layers; line02 has five. Disabled source layers remain reference-only. Original world endpoints rebase and rotate to +X. Root FX finish at 0.6s is used.
approximations: Unity world-unit-to-pixel scale is an estimate (160 px/unit), not actual in-game camera calibration.
GLSL reuses source D3D11 shader transcription; Unity postprocessing, scene depth and game camera are absent.
8-bit RGBA converts additive energy into ordinary coverage and clips HDR; float additive_linear_rgb.npy retains pre-clamp RGB.
Line endpoint binding is supplied by the DST caller; this sprite is a fixed straight segment, no target tracking controller included.
